resources.string: Studio wants to run this in %1$s:\n\n%2$s
Termux is not installed on this phone.
Studio is not allowed to run commands in Termux.
Termux did not start the command. Check allow-external-apps in ~/.termux/termux.properties.
Install %1$s from your Studio server on this phone?
The app could not be installed.
Allow Studio to install apps, then download the APK again.
No app on this phone can open that download.
The shared text was too long; Studio kept the first 20,000 characters.
Omi is not installed on this phone.
~/bin/omi-phone-ai.sh was not found in Termux. Set it up with Omi\'s phone AI guide (PHONE-LLM.md).

Studio runs the phone AI in Termux, and Termux has to allow it first.

1. Install Termux from F-Droid or GitHub (the Play Store build is outdated).

2. In Termux, run:

mkdir -p ~/.termux && echo "allow-external-apps = true" >> ~/.termux/termux.properties
termux-reload-settings

3. Try again. Android asks once to let Studio run Termux commands, and Studio shows every command before it runs.
